_note: Non-secret, tracked config. The store path is NEVER here — it resolves at runtime from ARC_LEADS_STORE with an os.homedir() default, because a personal filesystem path committed to a future-public repo is itself a leak (ADR-0410).
_sending_domain_note: Empty is STILL the honest value and it stays empty: no dedicated cold-outbound domain exists yet, and preflight REFUSES on it rather than passing vacuously. Filling this in belongs to the REAL campaign (parked Phase 05) and costs 2-4 calendar weeks of warm-up (ADR-0413). The rehearsal does NOT fill it -- see rehearsal_domain below. Phase 03 first proposed setting this to automemory.ai and that was the wrong mechanism: it would have made the repo's shipped default state 'the product domain is the sender', one env var away from live, which is the exact thing ADR-0402 exists to prevent.
_product_domains_note: Domains cold outbound may NEVER be sent from (ADR-0402), including any subdomain. automemory.ai was added 2026-08-09: it was absent, so the dedicated-domain refusal could not fire for the one domain ADR-0416 exists to control, and preflight would have reported it as a perfectly good dedicated domain.
_rehearsal_note: ADR-0416: the outreach path may bind the product domain ONLY in rehearsal mode. That unlock needs THREE independent signals and its absence is the safe state -- env ARC_LEADS_REHEARSAL=1 (declared), env ARC_LEADS_REHEARSAL_ALLOWLIST holding at least one address-shaped entry (locked), and the sending domain being exactly this rehearsal_domain (named). Rehearsal mode unlocks ONE named domain, never every product domain: without the name check, turning rehearsal on would also have unlocked lexos.app.
_dkim_selector_note: Per-mode, because the selector belongs to the PROVIDER not to us. The real cold domain will publish its own; the rehearsal domain is signed by Resend, whose selector is resend -- default._domainkey.automemory.ai is NXDOMAIN, so a single shared selector would have refused the rehearsal on DKIM after every other row went green.
_seed_evidence_note: REQ-07's Phase-3 entry gate: a dated seed-inbox smoke run, <=7 days old, across >=2 owned mailboxes. Read by preflight.seedSmokeFinding, which runs BEFORE the sending-domain refusal so that it is a reader that actually executes in the state this repo ships in.
_calendar_url_note: Where an interested reply's calendar draft points. Empty refuses the draft loudly rather than dropping a warm lead silently — the outreach.replied receipt is still written and the sequence still stops.
_caps_note: Ceilings are NOT here and cannot be. They live in caps.mjs CEILINGS/FLOORS (ADR-0403); config may only lower a limit. Two keys named per_ist_day_ceiling and touches_per_lead_ceiling used to sit in this block with no reader anywhere — removed 2026-08-05, and the block is now a closed key set that refuses an unknown key rather than ignoring it.
